Iso8601.description: ISO-8601 timestamp, always UTC with a trailing Z.

Milliseconds.description: Integer milliseconds. Media time is always integer ms, never float seconds.

Confidence.description: Confidence in [0,1]. 1 means certain, 0 means no support at all.

runId.description: One execution of a model or rule-based stage.

evtId.description: A semantic event: one thing that happened.

NarrativeRole.description: The structural job an event does in the finished piece.

asmId.description: One decision backend's verdict on one event.

Probability.description: Probability in [0,1]. Unlike Confidence this is a belief about the world, not about the model.

relId.description: An edge in the event graph.
